ticker_news.title: Microsoft Drops After Earnings—Why the Bull Case Holds
ticker_news.description: Microsoft stock plummeted 11% following strong earnings (EPS $4.14 vs. expected $3.86, revenue $81.27B vs. expected $80.28B) due to investor concerns about return on investment from massive capital expenditure plans for AI infrastructure. Despite beating expectations and 39% YOY Azure growth, the market worries that AI applications may not develop as expected, making the spending unnecessary. However, analysts maintain the bull case, noting Microsoft is spending heavily because it can't build data centers fast enough to meet demand, and Wall Street still sees 40% upside potential despite trimming targets.
ticker_news.author: Chris Markoch

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Slip As Trump Names Kevin Warsh As New Fed Chair Pick— SanDisk, Robinhood In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday as investors awaited President Trump's announcement of his Federal Reserve Chair pick. Major indices fell, with the Nasdaq 100 down 1.13% and Russell 2000 down 1.51%. Notable movers included SanDisk surging 20.53% on strong earnings, Deckers jumping 12.85% on record results, while Apple and Rocket Lab declined despite positive developments. Analyst Scott Wren from Wells Fargo maintains an optimistic outlook for 2026, expecting 2.4% GDP growth and record corporate earnings.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
